system.name: MrRoPE (Mixed-radix RoPE)
system.one_liner: A radix-conversion view of rotary position embedding that unifies RoPE-extension methods and yields the training-free MrRoPE-Uni and MrRoPE-Pro for longer contexts.

content.variant_note: three method strips funnel into a boxed theory with its formula, then a stepped bar chart compares radix conversion strategies
content.argues: RoPE, NTK and YaRN are special cases of one mixed-radix encoding, and a progressive conversion (MrRoPE-Pro) differs from regressive and uniform ones in the intermediate dimensions.
content.subject: Frequency profiles of RoPE, NTK and YaRN, the MrRoPE formula, and a stepped chart of radix conversion strategies over dimensions.

lessons.what_to_learn: To unify several prior methods, stack one tinted strip per method with the same mini plot, funnel them with labelled block arrows into a single theory box that carries the master formula, then show the special cases as variants of one schematic chart.
lessons.suits: Theory papers that recast several existing methods as special cases of one formulation and propose new members of that family.

evidence: Our key contributions are: (1) a unified theoretical framework for major RoPE-extensions
a progressive radix conversion method MrRoPE-Pro, which outperforms other SoTA methods across various tasks

summary: MrRoPE views RoPE-extension methods through radix conversion and unifies them in one formulation, from which the paper derives the training-free MrRoPE-Uni and MrRoPE-Pro. Figure 1 is the overall framework, a wide left-to-right drawing. On the left, under Distinct Frequency Transformation, three tinted strips (RoPE, NTK, YaRN) each sketch frequency waves from lower to higher dims. Three block arrows labelled Unify by converge on a MrRoPE Theory box with its mixed-radix formula beneath, and a thick Special Cases arrow leads to a stepped bar chart titled Radix Conversion Methodology: bars for NTK, YaRN, MrRoPE-Uni and MrRoPE-Pro over the dimensions, with the intermediate dimensions bracketed and hollow Regressive and Progressive arrows.
